instructions: Griasa holds the user's recorded meetings, the promises made in them, and what is known about each colleague. Start with list_commitments or get_next_meeting_brief for "what is open" and "what is next"; use search_meetings and get_meeting for what a meeting decided; ask for get_transcript only when a summary is not enough, since it returns everything that was said. These tools only read. If the user has allowed it, add_conversation offers a chat for their review and propose_close_commitment suggests that a promise is done; neither reads, changes or deletes anything, and the user decides.

tools.description: Open promises from recorded meetings, newest first, in two lists: 'mine' (what the user owes) and 'waiting_on_others' (what others owe the user); finished ones are left out. Use for "what do I owe", "what is overdue", "what is Anna still waiting on". For one colleague's whole picture use get_person; to get a name's exact spelling first, list_people.

limit.description: Most items in each of the two lists. Default 50; older promises past the limit are left out.

overdue_only.description: Only promises past their due date.

person.description: Only promises owned by this person: the exact name as list_people returns it, case-insensitive. Omit for everyone.

project.description: Only promises from meetings filed under this project id, from list_projects.

tools.name: list_commitments
tools.title: Open promises

tools.description: Everything known about one colleague: notes, email addresses, their open promises, and the last recorded meeting with them. Accepts a name or email in any spelling; if nobody matches, returns the known names.

name.description: Name or email address of the person.

tools.name: get_person
tools.title: Person

tools.description: Find recorded meetings by title or text, optionally with one participant, newest first. Returns id, title, date, participants and summary — never the transcript. Use the id with get_meeting or get_transcript.

person.description: Only meetings this person took part in.

project.description: Only meetings filed under this project id, from list_projects.

query.description: Words to look for in the title or text.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.title: Search meetings

tools.description: One meeting by id: summary, participants and the promises made in it. Does not include the transcript; use get_transcript for what was said.
tools.name: get_meeting
tools.title: Meeting

tools.description: The full transcript of one meeting: everything said, including remarks in passing. Long and sensitive; call it only when get_meeting's summary is not enough.
tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Meeting transcript

tools.description: Prep for the user's next calendar meeting: attendees, what each side promised the other, and what was discussed last time. Built from the calendar and recorded meetings; returns available=false with a reason when no meeting is coming up. Use before a call; for a meeting that already happened use search_meetings and get_meeting.
tools.name: get_next_meeting_brief
tools.title: Next meeting brief

tools.description: The user's calendar meetings in the next days, soonest first, each with its attendees and the open promises between the user and them: what the user promised them and what they promised the user. Use for "what's my week", "what do I owe the people I'm meeting". Only events with other people or a call link; all-day events are left out. Needs calendar access; returns available=false with a reason without it. For the very next call in detail, get_next_meeting_brief.

days.description: How many days ahead to look. Default 7, at most 14.

tools.name: list_upcoming_meetings
tools.title: Upcoming meetings

tools.description: A follow-up email for one meeting, written from Griasa's notes: the summary and who promised what for all participants, or, with person, only what that person and the user promised. Returns subject, body, the addresses Griasa knows and a mailto link. Griasa sends nothing: hand the link to the user or send the draft with the user's own mail tool after they confirm. Meeting id from search_meetings.

person.description: Only this participant's promises and the user's, addressed to them.

tools.name: draft_followup
tools.title: Follow-up draft

tools.description: Everyone Griasa knows by name, with how many of their promises are still open. Use to find the exact spelling before get_person or list_commitments.
tools.name: list_people
tools.title: People

tools.description: List every project the user files recordings and notes under, with id and name, in the order the user keeps them in Settings; unfiled items sit in an Inbox that is not listed. Use to answer what the user is working on or to match a meeting to a project; pass an id as project to search_meetings or list_commitments.
tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: Projects
